query: At 36 hours, culture is negative but symptoms persist. Explain the missing criteria for stopping antibiotics.
reference: A negative blood culture alone does not satisfy the stopping criteria at 36 hours. Initial suspicion must not have been strong, clinical condition must be reassuring with no indicators of possible infection, and C-reactive protein levels and trends must be reassuring. Persistent respiratory concerns mean these conditions are not all established. If antibiotics continue despite negative cultures, review their need at least every 24 hours with clinical progress and serial results.
